name: system-architect
description: Keep AI coding agents inside owned modules and explicit interfaces.

interface.shortDescription: Protect module ownership and integration contracts.
interface.longDescription: Places product changes into independently owned modules, protects shared shells, and validates file scope before agents integrate code.
defaultPrompt: Place this change in one owned module and define its interfaces.
Check whether this diff crosses a registered module boundary.
Extract this feature from a frontend monolith without replacing the shell.
